title: Build branch targeting UI
userStory: As a developer, I want to configure git branches for each task so that work lands in the right places.
acceptanceCriteria: Task form shows: base branch, feature branch name, PR target branch
Base branch dropdown populated from workspace's remote branches
Feature branch name auto-suggested from task title (slugified)
PR target defaults to base branch (configurable)
Branch config editable until task enters Executing state
